fields.statement: QA at b380a501f (cycle 2): built rhiza with go build -trimpath and ran `rhiza version --channel` against a local python http.server channel (RHIZA_TEST_CHANNEL_BASE_URL) with RHIZA_TEST_VERSION set. The cycle-1 ordering bug is fixed. These report newer: v0.2.0-5-gabc1234 over v0.2.0; v0.2.1-12-gdef over v0.2.1-5-gabc; v0.2.1-main.10+abc over main.9; v0.2.0-rc.10 over rc.2; v0.2.0 over rc.10; v0.10.0 over v0.9.0; v0.2.1-main.3 over v0.2.0-7-gabc-dirty; v0.2.0 over dev and over the Go pseudo-version build. These report not newer: each reverse pair, the same version, v0.2.0 against v0.3.0, rc.1 against v0.2.0, and main.3+abc against main.3+abc-dirty. --json gives channel/current/newest/newer. An unknown channel exits 2 with a usage error. A malformed manifest and an unreachable base (127.0.0.1:1) exit 1 with a clean error. Nothing was written in the empty cwd. Against the real published channel, release reports v0.1.0 as not newer than the v0.1.1 pseudo-version build. go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/version-channel passes.

QA at b380a501f (cycle 2): the built binary's Resolver.Newest read release and latest manifests from a local HTTP channel and from the real github.com release channel (v0.1.0). It rejected a malformed manifest ('malformed manifest: invalid character') and a 404. go test -trimpath ./internal/release/... passes.
